name: sync
description: Track work in Plane with an atomic claim, so two agents never take the same task. Ships the coordination tools, the working rules, and the liveness monitor that keeps a lease alive while you work.

gateway_url.title: Gateway address
gateway_url.description: The host your team's sync gateway runs on, e.g. https://sync.your-company.internal — usually 'mcp.' in front of your Plane host. Ask whoever runs it; it is not a secret, and it is not your Plane address. Leave off the /mcp — that is added for you.
